subject: Request: Post-audit gap endorsement (SOC 2 Type II) — Cygnus Health
messages:
From: Tom Conway <t.conway@cygnushealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@cygnushealth.com>, security@cygnushealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-audit endorsement request — SOC 2 Type II (gap coverage)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared earlier (we have the PDF on file). Procurement is requesting a short endorsement/"post-audit gap" letter that confirms Redwood's controls coverage from 2024-01-01 through today while the next report is in progress. Specifically they want:

- A one-page letter stating the report period covered by the attached SOC 2 Type II (ending 2023-12-31) and that there have been no material control changes since that period, or an explanation where applicable.
- Confirmation of the systems/services in scope (authentication, encryption at rest, logging/audit trails).
- A contact for follow-up and a signed PDF they can accept for procurement.

Target timeline: procurement needs this by COB 30-Nov for a renewal. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide this endorsement and whether you prefer a signed letter or a DocuSign envelope?

I've attached the SOC 2 report we have on file for reference. If you need any additional evidence lists or control artifacts, let me know and I can prod our InfoSec team.

Appreciate the quick help — Tom

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_20240101-20231231.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Conway <t.conway@cygnushealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-audit endorsement request — SOC 2 Type II (gap coverage)

Tom — thanks for the note and for attaching the report. We can provide a short endorsement letter to bridge the post-report period. A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope it correctly:

1) Is Cygnus looking for an assertion of "no material changes" to all controls in scope, or only the security common criteria you listed (auth/encryption/logging)?
2) Do you need the letter to reference the exact report period (e.g., "period ended 2023-12-31") and include our control owner contacts?
3) Preferred delivery: signed PDF from our security team (legal@redwood.com) or DocuSign?

I'm looping in Jordan and Stephanie to draft and review. Jordan — can you pull our evidence index for the in-scope services and draft a one-page endorsement? Stephanie — FYI for legal sign-off.

I'll aim to get a draft back to you within 48 hours.

Best,
Irene
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Post-report gap endorsement for Cygnus Health (v1)

Irene — attaching a first-pass endorsement. Key points in the draft:

- Identifies the SOC 2 Type II report period ending 2023-12-31.
- States that, to the best of Redwood's knowledge, there have been no material changes to controls in the defined scope affecting security since the report end date.
- Lists in-scope services: Authentication (AuthN), Data-at-rest encryption, Logging & Monitoring (Logplex), Key Management (KMS), and Model Serving Platform.
- Includes a short paragraph on availability of detailed evidence on request and provides a contact.

Questions I put in comments (see attached DOCX):
- Do we need to explicitly call out the period the next SOC audit will cover or language about ongoing remediation?
- Should we include the phrase "no material changes" or soften to "no material changes that would have a material adverse effect on the controls evaluated"?

Also attached: redwood-evidence-index.csv with the mapping of control statements to artifacts (logs retention, KMS attestations, change-control tickets).

If that looks OK, I can incorporate legal's redlines and produce a signed PDF for Tom.

Attachments: bridge_draft_cygnus_20261123.docx, redwood-evidence-index.csv

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Post-report gap endorsement for Cygnus Health (v1)

Jordan — thanks for the rapid draft. A few requested edits before we send to the customer: 

- Please replace the blanket phrase "no material changes" with: "no material changes to the controls in scope that would reasonably be expected to affect the effectiveness of those controls since the report end date (2023-12-31)."
- Add a short appendix line that points to the evidence index (we can attach the CSV).
- Under services in scope, switch "Model Serving Platform" to the specific product name we provide to Cygnus (ModelServe-v2).
- Add signatory block for Chief Security Officer (Stephanie) with an option for DocuSign.

Once Jordan updates the docx I will do a quick legal check. Tom — FYI we'll attach the evidence index and the SOC 2 PDF.

Thanks — Irene

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Post-audit gap endorsement — Cygnus Health

Tom / Cygnus team —

Attached is the final endorsement letter for your procurement file. Summary:

- Report referenced: SOC 2 Type II report for the period ended 2023-12-31 (attached).
- Endorsement statement: "To the best of our knowledge, there have been no material changes to the controls in scope that would reasonably be expected to affect the effectiveness of those controls since the report end date (2023-12-31)."
- In-scope services called out: AuthN, Data-at-rest encryption, Logplex (logging/monitoring), KMS, ModelServe-v2.
- Evidence index attached for reference.

Delivery & signature: I have signed the PDF and we can also send via DocuSign if you prefer. DocuSign envelope (if needed): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-placeholder

Please confirm receipt and let us know if procurement needs any additional artifacts (control-run books, retention policies or specific KMS attestations). If you need a tailored statement for a specific control family, we can amend.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Chief Security Officer
Redwood Inference
